title: Order Status and Returns Voice Agent
summary: A multilingual voice agent that answers where-is-my-order calls from live courier data, starts returns and exchanges under your policy, and hands disputes to an agent with context.

seo.title: Order Status and Returns Voice Agent | VipraTech
seo.description: Voice agent for e-commerce and D2C that answers order status calls, books returns and exchanges under policy and gives refund status in Hindi and English.

problem.intro: For most online sellers, where-is-my-order is the largest single reason customers get in touch, followed by returns, exchanges and refund status. Agents answer by switching between the OMS, courier panels and the payment gateway, while customers in smaller towns prefer to call and speak in their own language.

pain_points.title: WISMO fills the queue
pain_points.detail: Simple status calls crowd out the complaints and disputes that genuinely need a person.

pain_points.title: Too many screens
pain_points.detail: Agents look up the OMS, courier tracking, reverse pickup status and refund status separately to give one answer.

pain_points.title: Return policy applied unevenly
pain_points.detail: Rules on non-returnable categories, return windows and exchange stock are interpreted differently by different agents.

pain_points.title: Language and channel preference
pain_points.detail: Many customers would rather call in Hindi, Tamil, Bengali or another language than use chat or email.

solution.overview: We build an inbound voice agent connected to your OMS, courier tracking and payment gateway. It verifies the caller by registered number or OTP, finds the order and answers status questions from live tracking, including delays and failed delivery attempts. For returns and exchanges it calls your policy engine, which checks category, window, condition and exchange stock. It books the reverse pickup, explains the refund timeline and sends a WhatsApp confirmation, in Hindi, English or a regional language. Disputes, damaged-item complaints, high-value orders and frustrated callers go to a human agent with a call summary.
capabilities: Verifies callers by registered number or OTP before sharing order details
Answers status from live OMS and courier data, including delays, failed attempts and rescheduling
Starts returns and exchanges through your policy engine, including category, window and stock rules
Books reverse pickups and gives refund status from the payment gateway or wallet
Speaks Hindi, English, Hinglish and regional languages, with WhatsApp follow-up messages
Hands over to a human agent with a call summary for disputes, damage claims and escalations

workflow.title: Verify the caller
workflow.detail: The agent matches the calling number to orders or sends an OTP, then confirms which order the call is about.

workflow.title: Understand the request
workflow.detail: The caller explains in their own words, and the agent classifies it as status, return, exchange, refund or other.

workflow.title: Fetch live data
workflow.detail: Order, shipment, pickup and refund status are fetched from the OMS, courier and payment systems.

workflow.title: Apply policy
workflow.detail: For returns and exchanges, the policy engine decides eligibility and the agent explains the result.

workflow.title: Act or hand over
workflow.detail: Eligible requests are booked; disputes, damage claims and escalations go to a human agent with a summary.

workflow.title: Confirm on WhatsApp
workflow.detail: The customer receives a confirmation with the pickup window or the next update.

inputs: Inbound calls to the support number
Order and return data from the OMS
Shipment tracking from couriers or aggregators
Refund status from the payment gateway
Return and exchange policy by category
outputs: Answered status calls and booked returns or exchanges
Reverse pickup requests in the OMS or courier system
Daily report of intents, languages and handover reasons
human_in_the_loop: Disputes, damaged or wrong item claims, high-value orders and any caller who asks for a person go to a human agent with a summary. Refunds outside policy are decided only by your CX team.
integrations: OMS such as Unicommerce, Shopify or an in-house system
Helpdesk such as Freshdesk or Zendesk
guardrails: Caller verification before any order detail is shared
Return eligibility decided by the policy engine, not the language model
Delivery dates quoted only from courier data
Immediate handover on request or detected frustration
Card and bank details never collected by voice
compliance_notes: Return, refund and grievance information follows your published policy, in line with the Consumer Protection (E-Commerce) Rules 2020.
Call recordings and transcripts are personal data under the DPDP Act 2023; PII is redacted in logs and retention is limited.

pilot.scope: Status and return-initiation calls for one brand or channel in Hindi and English, with overflow and after-hours calls routed to the agent first.
deliverables: Call flows and policy rules agreed with CX
Working agent on a pilot number or overflow queue
Integrations with OMS, courier tracking and refund status
Pilot report on resolution, accuracy and handovers

what_we_measure.how: Calls completed by the agent with no repeat call about the same order within the agreed window.
QA review of a sample of return and exchange outcomes against your policy.
Logged reason for each transfer, reviewed weekly with CX.
Post-call survey compared with human-handled calls of the same type.

faqs.q: Will customers know they are talking to an AI?
faqs.a: Yes. The agent introduces itself as an automated assistant, and callers can ask for a person at any point. Clear disclosure also reduces complaints.

faqs.q: How does it handle angry customers?
faqs.a: It listens for frustration and requests for a person, then hands over with a summary so the customer does not repeat themselves. It does not argue or try to keep the caller.
It reports refund status and books returns that your policy engine approves. Refund exceptions are decided by your CX team.

faqs.q: Which systems do you need access to?
faqs.a: Read access to orders, shipments and refunds, and write access to create returns and pickups. We use your existing APIs, or a middleware layer if your OMS has limited APIs.
